# state interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:stateInterval`](gmeow-stateInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/stateInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)

The time interval over which this language state is asserted to hold — e.g. Old English 450–1150 CE. A relator carries its period this way (matching [`VersionMembership`](../classes/gmeow-VersionMembership.md)'s [`membershipInterval`](gmeow-membershipInterval.md)) rather than via statement-level [`validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md)/validUntil alone.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:LanguageState`](../classes/gmeow-LanguageState.md) -> [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)

Use [`gmeow:stateInterval`](gmeow-stateInterval.md) from [`gmeow:LanguageState`](../classes/gmeow-LanguageState.md) to [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
